name: Predictive
description: Synthetic fixture tag: a claim that flatly forecasts what will happen.
when_to_use:
Decide from the markers in the main assertion of the claim.
1. Fires on an unconditional forecast marker: will, is expected to, is projected to, is likely to.
2. The forecast must be stated flatly, with no scenario wrapper.
3. Does NOT fire on an attributed forecast.
example_claims:
Sales will double next year.
The market is projected to grow.

name: Hypothetical
description: Synthetic fixture tag: a claim about a scenario that has not happened.
when_to_use:
A forecast under a scenario is Hypothetical, not Predictive.
1. Fires when the claim is conditional: if, would, could, might.
2. Fires on an assumed outcome of an election or a vote.
3. Does NOT fire on a past counterfactual stated as fact.
example_claims:
If the vote passes, the budget would grow.
A new tax could raise revenue.

name: Context-dependent
description: Synthetic fixture tag: a claim that cannot be understood without text outside it.
when_to_use:
Ask which one, about a definite phrase.
1. Fires on a pronoun or a definite phrase with no antecedent in the claim.
2. Does NOT fire on a bare generic.
example_claims:
He said it works.
The committee rejected the proposal.

name: Source inaccessible
description: Synthetic fixture tag: an attached source that cannot be read.
when_to_use:
Needs the source text, which the MVP does not fetch.
1. Fires when every attached source is unreadable.
2. Does NOT fire when a readable source exists.
example_claims: A claim whose only source returns an error page.

name: Editor verified
description: Synthetic fixture tag: an editor checked the claim by hand. The agent never writes it.
when_to_use:
Human only.
1. Set by an editor after a manual check.
example_claims: A claim an editor has confirmed.

name: Unsourced
description: Synthetic fixture tag: a claim with no sources. Computed by code from the sources count.
when_to_use:
Computed, not judged.
1. Fires when the sources count is zero.
example_claims: A claim with an empty source list.
